headline: WSN @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.87 at ATL 5.46, with a projected total of 10.33. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: WSN moved +1.14 runs while ATL moved -0.04, changing the projected margin by +1.18 runs. The projected total climbed +1.09, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Grant Holmes has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Daylen Lile, CJ Abrams, Michael Harris II, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Mateo, Nasim Nuñez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
